verdict.rationale: Modal Sandboxes explicitly supports creating a Sandbox with a custom Image ('Create a Sandbox with the specified Image'), custom dependencies ('Custom images, any dependency'), and configurable resources (gpu, cpu, memory, region), fully enabling bring-your-own-container-image workflows. missing for 10: no independent hands-on confirmation of custom image builds/Dockerfile import specifics, and no detail on image registry integration or template reuse patterns.
